choose.when: r.delete_flag = FALSE AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.status = 'ACTIVE'
(r.delete_flag = TRUE OR r.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR r.status = 'DELETED')

mapper.select: SELECT FROM tbl_dim_repository r INNER JOIN tbl_dim_project p ON p.project_id = r.project_id WHERE r.repository_id = #{repositoryId}

SELECT FROM tbl_dim_repository r INNER JOIN tbl_dim_project p ON p.project_id = r.project_id
ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.repo_name_masked ASC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_dim_repository ( repository_id, project_id, repo_name_masked, host_type, default_branch, repo_url_hash, status, delete_flag, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at, deleted_by ) VALUES ( #{repositoryId}, #{projectId}, #{repoNameMasked}, #{hostType}, #{defaultBranch}, #{repoUrlHash}, #{status}::record_status, #{deleteFlag}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{deletedAt}, #{deletedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_dim_repository SET project_id = #{projectId}, repo_name_masked = #{repoNameMasked}, host_type = #{hostType}, default_branch = #{defaultBranch}, repo_url_hash = #{repoUrlHash}, status = #{status}::record_status, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE repository_id = #{repositoryId} AND delete_flag = FALSE AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE tbl_dim_repository SET status = 'DELETED', delete_flag = TRUE, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE repository_id = #{repositoryId} AND delete_flag = FALSE AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE'
